change: Added 'Rebuild from History' button on Revisit Tracker page (Manager-visible) that wipes and re-scans all historical inspections using the tightened v351 matching logic (stricter word match + closest-visit priority), so the 32/22/8 bucket numbers reflect the more accurate detection instead of the old data. Requires confirmation before running since it's destructive to existing revisit records (originals are recomputed from source inspections, so no underlying data is lost).
